_comment: NAFNet models: each entry is a Model-popup choice, the NAFNet constructor args, and the checkpoint filename expected at models/<weight>. Deblur and denoise use different block layouts, so the arch args are per-model. A 'download' block ({url, sha256, bytes}) enables the node's Download Model button, which fetches and verifies the checkpoint as a background task; without one the model is manual-install only (see README.md).
